data.title: Fully Engage Social Media Posts (TMS)
data.description:
NOTE:
- Read the post before commenting.
- Minimum of 1-10 minute screen recording or livestream is required.
- Attach a screenshot of your profile on the platforms used.
- Only male accounts with 30+ followers may comment; comment must be based on the post content.
- Female accounts with 30+ followers may only like, bookmark, and share.
-No 0 follower accounts or bot accounts.
-For platforms YT, Reddit, Discord  no minimum followers required
-For Videos or Reels, watch till the end

RESOURCES:

https://www.instagram.com/p/DelOMI6xTJQ/?srtk=MXRiOTV3bTFrZnFyMw==

https://x.com/tmsdiamondpicks/status/2111319348631818255?s=46


STYLE: Comment should read like a real person reacting, casual and specific to the post content, no hashtags, minimal emoji.

What you'll do:
1. Click the links found in the "RESOURCES" be ready to login to your (Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, Facebook, etc.), like the posts.
2. Leave a genuine and unique comment on the post, subscribe or follow the page, casual and specific to the post content, no hashtags, no emoji. (MALE ONLY)
3. Save or bookmark the post and share it via DM to 2 real users. (FEMALE AND MALE)
4. Go live and perform all actions (like, comment, save, share,follow, subscribe) during a livestream at least 1 minute long.

Requirements:
- Must have a social media account (Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, Facebook, etc.) ready to use.
- Must have a minimum of 30+ followers on that platform.
- Account must belong to a male user to comment; female accounts may only like, save, and share.
- Account must already follow TMS on the platform used.
- Comment must be genuine, original, unique, relevant to the post, and land as a top comment, no generic phrases or emoji-only comments.
- Do not copy another earner's proof.
- Submission will be rejected if any action is missing, comment is copied/generic/AI-sounding, share is not sent, or the account is not already following TMS.

What to submit:
• A minimum of 1-10  minute livestream (Depends on the posts) or screen recording showing the earner performing the like, comment, save, and share actions on the post.
• Attach a screenshot of every posts you engaged
• Attach a screenshot of your profile showing the followers

data.title: Clip 5 Shane Gillis moments for Whop AI's entertainment tab
data.description:
Cut short clips of Shane Gillis for a new entertainment tab on the Whop AI website.

What you'll do:
1. Find Shane Gillis footage (stand-up specials, podcast appearances, interviews) from a publicly available source.
2. Pick a funny, standalone moment and cut a 30 to 60 second clip.
3. Export the clip in MP4, MOV, or WebM format.
5. Attach clips and the source link for each submission :)

Requirements:
• Must use publicly available footage (YouTube, podcasts, specials).
• Each clip must feature Shane Gillis as the main focus, not another guest.
• Each clip must stand alone without needing extra context to be funny.

What to submit:
• A 5 minute screen-share livestream showing you browsing source footage and cutting one clip start to finish.
• Attach 5 video clips, each 30 to 60 seconds, in MP4, MOV, or WebM.
• Include the source link for each clip in the submission notes.

data.title: Clip Content into Short Video (1k view minimum)
data.description:
Create and publish one fast-paced, retention-edited clip from the provided Anon Betting content. Clip must reach 1000+ views to be considered. 

What you'll do:
1. Choose the strongest 15–60 second moment from this folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/19FuOdOulQL9e_TQgJwzEY7sagsr8U7Wz
2. Edit it vertically in 9:16 at 1080x1920 or higher, beginning directly on the strongest hook and removing introductions, dead air, and filler.
3. Add large, accurate captions and useful cuts, zooms, or graphics. Keep the style clean, sports-focused, and similar to the Reels on @Anon_Betting.
4. Publish it publicly on TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts and tag @AnonPicks on TikTok or @ANON_BETTING on Instagram when applicable.
5. After the post qualifies, attach the original video and live post to your submission.

You can post as many clips as you like to reach the threshold. 


STYLE / EDITING GUIDELINES:
- Fast-paced, clean, vertical 9:16.
- Use large readable captions, remove dead air, and use cuts, zooms, sports visuals, or B-roll when helpful.
- Keep the tone confident, entertaining, and sports-focused. Subtle purple/black Anon branding is encouraged.
- Avoid slow intros, excessive effects, tiny captions, misleading edits, or filler.
- Edit for retention. Remove pauses, dead air, filler words, slow sections, or anything that makes the clip feel boring.
- Use zooms, cuts, emphasis, screenshots, graphics, sound effects, B-roll, or other editing techniques when they improve retention. Do not over-edit. However, the main focus should always remain on the original Anon Betting content and message.


WE WILL REJECT IF: 

* Wrong source content is used
* Video is low quality or not 9:16
* Captions are missing, inaccurate, or unreadable
* Watermarks or unrelated branding are included
* The clip contains unnecessary dead air or a weak intro
* The original meaning is changed
* Fake results, statistics, testimonials, or claims are added
* Content impersonates Anon Betting
* Content is copied or repeatedly resubmitted
* Fake/botted views or engagement are used
* Content violates Whop or social platform policies
* Content is posted on an account clearly branded for another campaign

Requirements:
• Export each clip in the highest quality possible, preferably 1080x1920 or higher.
• Must use an account you control; accounts impersonating Anon Betting or branded for another campaign do not qualify.
• Tag or mention @ANON_BETTING on IG / @AnonPicks on TikTok where appropriate and include the provided CTA/link instructions.
• The post must reach at least 1,000 public organic views to qualify. Do not submit if your clips have less. 
• Bots, paid traffic, purchased engagement, engagement groups, or other artificial promotion will disqualify the submission.
• Edits must preserve the original meaning and must not fabricate results, statistics, wins, quotes, or claims.
• Watermarks, unrelated branding, copied clips, or duplicate submissions will not qualify.
• An approved post must remain public for at least 90 days.

What to submit:
• A 1–2 minute shared-screen livestream showing your profile, live post, publish date, and visible view count of at least 1,000.
• Attach the original vertical clip as an MP4 or MOV and include the source filename and timestamps.
• Attach the live TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts URL.

data.title: Edit Motion Graphics, B-Roll, and Grading for Long-Form Video
data.description:
- READ ALL GUIDES IN ADDITIONAL NOTES. MUST READ AND FOLLOW EDITOR GUIDE LINKED
- Deliverable: Deliver one finished video, 13 to 14 minutes long, 4K, with no editing-app watermarks
- Script: Match the Video Script line by line. Every bracket in the script is a shot instruction and all of them are required
- Charts: Build the 6 charts listed in the notes as animated graphics, and animate the supplied per-ballpark map PNG in the image assets folder during that part of the video
- B-Roll / Graphics: Any time RudeBets is not looking directly at the camera, b-roll or motion graphics must be on screen.
- Style: Match the pacing and styling rules listed in the notes. This is slow documentary pacing, not a fast-cut YouTube edit
- Music & Audio: Run one continuous cinematic underscore, cutting to full silence on the 3 beats listed in the notes
- Captions & On-Screen Text: Caption the face-cam sections only, never the chart sections

Opportunity for full-time hire (up to $250 / video if selected). 

Raw Video: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/17mrwQf7-BpbtUtfhg_0qCDoxaoFJYl8w

Script to Follow: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1J68beFHKuivUJc1qnu4jOsnHnwn1gBDPhyPyc92Kzzs/edit?usp=sharing 

Editor Guide: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IprG0hAjJqDrmu_yC0tA3xDMbi1pjqpxgMsdtCHdIAw/edit?usp=sharing 

Image Assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IpNVGkGNb4AMOt0uL02DuORo39WnlWSY 

Style Rules:
- MUST READ AND FOLLOW EDITOR GUIDE
- Charts: dark backgrounds, post-All-Star-break stats in RED, pre-break stats in BLUE
- Charts: animate over 3 to 5 seconds, hold at least 3 seconds after it lands, 8 to 15 seconds on screen
- Average shot length 4 to 6 seconds. Never more than 8 seconds on face-cam without a cutaway,
  and back to face-cam within 3 seconds of any b-roll
- A plain EVIDENCE #1, EVIDENCE #2 text card between sections, clean cut, no transition effects
- Cutaways are AI-generated atmospheric b-roll, MLB gameplay clips under 10 seconds each with the
  voiceover over the top, and 3 to 5 second ESPN talking-head clips blurred or vignetted
- Underscore sits at about 15% volume the whole way through

Submission:
- livestream your editing canvas proving you edited the video yourself (stolen content = rejection) 
- submit a link to your edited video as additional proof after you submit the livestream
